assumptions: docs/wiki keeps at least one mermaid chart. If a restructure legitimately removes the last chart, the honest fix is to delete the job, not to let it pass on zero.

The zero-denominator branch of the mermaid step can be exercised offline: with an empty docs/wiki the loop body never runs, so npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli is never invoked. The test therefore runs the real shell verbatim with no network and no Chromium.
